SINERGO.MenuHint: Connect this browser to your own copy of the Sinergo app and send a character to it.
SINERGO.AddressHint: Shown in Sinergo under Settings → Foundry sync.
SINERGO.CodeHint: Six digits, shown by Sinergo while pairing is open. Only needed once.
SINERGO.NoCharacters: You do not own any characters in this world, so there is nothing to send.
SINERGO.GMNotice: You are the GM, so Foundry counts you as the owner of every character. Players only ever see their own.
SINERGO.ErrUnreachable: Could not reach Sinergo at {url}. Is the app open with Foundry sync switched on, and on the same network?
SINERGO.ErrMixed: Foundry is served over HTTPS, so the browser blocks a plain http:// request to another machine. If Sinergo is running on this computer, use its 127.0.0.1 address — that one is allowed. Otherwise use Copy and paste into Sinergo.
SINERGO.ErrAuth: Sinergo rejected this connection. Pair again to get a fresh token.
SINERGO.Copied: Character JSON copied. Paste it into Sinergo → Import.
